title: Login success with valid credentials
description: Verify that users can log in successfully with correct username and password and are routed to appropriate dashboards based on their role.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input valid username and password
Click the login button
Verify the user is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard matching their role (Cashier, Supervisor, Manager, Super Admin)
Verify that route protection prevents access to unauthorized pages

title: Login failure with invalid credentials
description: Verify that login fails when incorrect username or password is entered and appropriate error message is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Input invalid username or password
Click the login button
Verify login is denied with an error message indicating invalid credentials

title: Role-based permission enforcement on POS actions
description: Verify that role-based permissions are enforced server-side and at the database level, restricting or allowing actions like sales, price overrides, voids, and inventory adjustments.

steps.description: Log in as Cashier
Attempt to perform a price override
Verify the server denies the price override and an error response is returned
Log in as Supervisor
Perform a price override within allowed limits on POS
Verify the price override is accepted and logged with an immutable audit record
Attempt to void a transaction
Verify the void operation succeeds and creates an immutable audit log
Log in as Cashier and attempt to void a transaction
Verify void operation is denied by server and database permission level

title: POS transaction with fractional quantities and tax calculation
description: Verify that the POS interface supports fractional quantities and applies configured tax rules with proper deterministic rounding.

steps.description: Log in as Cashier
Go to the POS interface
Add product to cart with fractional quantity (e.g. 1.75 units)
Verify the price and tax are calculated with configured tax rules and rounding
Confirm that calculated totals, taxes, and rounding match expected deterministic logic
Complete the sale transaction
Verify the transaction is immutable and stored correctly with full audit logs

title: Inventory management with immutable historical intake and adjustments
description: Verify inventory management tracks quantities, weights, costs, and records immutable historical intake and adjustment records with audit logs.

steps.description: Log in as Supervisor
Add new inventory intake record with product quantity, weight, and cost per unit
Verify the intake record is saved immutably and cannot be silently modified
Adjust inventory quantity via adjustment record
Verify adjustment record is append-only, logged with user details, timestamp, and cannot be altered
Attempt to modify a historical inventory intake record
Verify system rejects silent mutations or modifications; all changes must be logged as new audit entries

title: Soft-disable customer account instead of deletion
description: Verify that customers can be soft-disabled, preventing further transactions, but preserving purchase history and notes.

steps.description: Log in as Manager
Search for an existing customer profile
Soft-disable the customer account
Verify the customer entry is marked disabled but still accessible for viewing purchase history and notes
Attempt to create a new sale or transaction for the soft-disabled customer
Verify the system prevents transactions involving soft-disabled customers
Search for the disabled customer and verify data integrity is maintained

title: Audit log generation for sensitive actions
description: Verify that all sensitive actions including price overrides, inventory adjustments, voids, refunds, and permission changes generate immutable, append-only audit logs.

steps.description: Log in as Supervisor
Perform a price override on a sales transaction
Adjust inventory quantities
Void a sales transaction
Verify each action generates a new immutable audit log entry including timestamp, user ID, action type, and details
Log in as Super Admin
Change user permissions
Verify permission changes are recorded in immutable audit logs
Attempt to modify an audit log entry
Verify that modification of audit log entries is prohibited

title: Mobile POS usability and performance
description: Verify that the mobile POS interface supports one-handed operation and allows new staff to complete a sale within two minutes.

steps.description: Access POS interface on a mobile device
Simulate new staff user completing sale process from product selection to checkout
Measure and verify that the entire sale process completes under two minutes
Verify interface elements are reachable and operable with one hand (e.g., large buttons, optimized layout)
Confirm system responsiveness and no performance lag on mobile network

title: Deterministic and reproducible tax and pricing calculations
description: Verify that tax and pricing calculations conform to configured business tax rules and explicit rounding standards yielding deterministic and reproducible results.

steps.description: Configure various tax rates and settings for a test business profile
Perform multiple sales transactions with diverse products and quantities
Verify calculated taxes and prices match expected outcomes based on configured rules and rounding policies
Repeat transactions and check that results are identical and reproducible
Change rounding configurations and verify calculations adjust accordingly, preserving determinism

title: Credit Engine integration and credit limit enforcement
description: Verify that the AI-powered Credit Engine integrates seamlessly, analyzes credit limits, and enforces credit restrictions during sales and customer credit queries.

steps.description: Log in as Sales or Manager user
Access customer credit information via integrated Credit Engine
Verify credit limit and analysis data is retrieved and displayed correctly
Attempt to execute a sale exceeding the customer's credit limit
Verify the system denies the sale or requires override approval according to policy
Verify audit log records approval or denial of transactions involving credit engine enforcement

title: Reporting and audit log completeness and accuracy
description: Verify that all reports (sales, inventory movement, tax summaries, user actions) are complete, accurate, and reflect immutable, append-only data.

steps.description: Log in as Manager
Generate sales report for defined date range
Verify sales report matches transaction records from database exactly
Generate inventory movement report
Verify inventory movements match immutable intake and adjustment records
Generate tax summary report
Verify tax totals are consistent with individual transactions and tax rules
Access user action audit logs
Verify audit logs show append-only entries for sensitive actions without gaps or tampering

title: Server-side enforced route protection and permission validation
description: Verify that all permissions and route protections are enforced strictly server-side, independent of UI controls, preventing unauthorized data access or mutations.

steps.description: Attempt to access restricted API endpoints or database operations directly with insufficient permissions
Verify server denies access with proper error codes consistently
Login as lower role user (i.e. Cashier) and try to modify resources only permitted for higher roles (Manager, Super Admin)
Verify no unauthorized data changes are allowed, and access is blocked at the API/database level
Manipulate UI or client-side requests to simulate privilege escalation
Verify server rejects any unauthorized elevated requests

title: Prevention of use of mock data in production environment
description: Verify that the production environment rejects or does not contain any mock or placeholder data and all data conforms to live production requirements.

steps.description: Deploy system to production environment
Access different modules including POS, inventory, customers, and reports
Verify no sample, mock, or test data is present or used in any live queries or reports
Attempt to inject test/mock data using any API or UI input
Verify system rejects non-production data inputs or flags inappropriate data
